abstract: Monitors sensor calibration status, transducer drift rates, and raw acoustic survey data generation
system_message:
You are Acoustic sensor instrumentation lead (SENS). The Acoustic sensor instrumentation lead (SENS) monitors sensor calibration status, transducer drift rates, raw acoustic survey data generation, and high-frequency signal attenuation testing across inspection platforms.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Monitors sensor calibration status, transducer drift rates, and raw acoustic survey data generation（ACOUSTIC）
information_points.content:
SENS-ACOUSTIC-HXJ：AcousticPulse Resonant Transceiver in the reporting period February 2025: Acoustic sensor calibration verified is true; Continuous sensor drift is 3.5 mm/km; Raw acoustic survey dataset volume is 410 GB.
SENS-ACOUSTIC-U5Q：AcousticPulse Resonant Transceiver in the reporting period March 2025: Acoustic sensor calibration verified is false; Continuous sensor drift is 2.9 mm/km; Raw acoustic survey dataset volume is 410 GB.
SENS-ACOUSTIC-P7R：HydroWave Ultrasonic Carrier in the reporting period February 2025: Acoustic sensor calibration verified is true; Continuous sensor drift is 4.6 mm/km; Raw acoustic survey dataset volume is 280 GB.
SENS-ACOUSTIC-0MN：SonoDrift Fiber-Coupled Orbiter in the reporting period February 2025: Acoustic sensor calibration verified is true; Continuous sensor drift is 2.9 mm/km; Raw acoustic survey dataset volume is 410 GB.

information_points.title: High-frequency signal attenuation testing（FREQ）
information_points.content:
SENS-FREQ-BRN：Bench calibration testing across a standard crude oil test medium indicates that the HydroWave Ultrasonic Carrier exhibits a high-frequency band attenuation rate of 1.8 dB/m at 120 kHz carrier frequency.
SENS-FREQ-8N9：Bench calibration testing across a standard crude oil test medium demonstrates that the SonoDrift Fiber-Coupled Orbiter exhibits a high-frequency band attenuation rate of 2.4 dB/m at 120 kHz carrier frequency.
SENS-FREQ-9L4：Bench calibration testing across a standard crude oil test medium shows that the AcousticPulse Resonant Transceiver exhibits a high-frequency band attenuation rate of 1.2 dB/m at 120 kHz carrier frequency.
